statements.t: (the “Company”) currently estimates that its revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was between approximately US$0.4 million and US$0.5 million.

The issuance of the Company’s shares in the private placement transactions described under Item 8.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K will be made in reliance on the exemption provided by Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act, for the offer and sale of securities not involving a public offering, and Rule 506(b) of Regulation D promulgated under the Securities Act.

The Company intends to issue shares of its common stock in a private placement transaction for gross proceeds of approximately $4.2 million, before fees, which private placement will be consummated in one or more closings dated on or about the date of this Form 8-K.

In September 2026, the Company entered into a non-binding letter of intent with a data center developer (the “Developer”) to form a joint venture, special purpose vehicle or similar structure to develop, finance and operate up to approximately 60 MW of AI data center capacity at the Developer’s campus, including capacity intended to support the deployment described above, with a target commercial operation date…

The Company has formed a jointly managed limited liability company with a data center operating partner in Europe (the “Operating Partner”), through which the Company intends to deliver GPU deployments at the Operating Partner’s facility, including the deployment described above, with the Operating Partner acting as managed services provider for the facility.
The Company intends to develop the site as an AI data center.

risks.t: the non-binding nature of the term sheets and letters of intent described above
the availability and allocation of GPU hardware
